description: This file defines a mixin for Bootstrap that generates grid classes based on a configurable number of columns, breakpoints, and gutters. It facilitates the creation of responsive grid layouts by dynamically creating classes such as .col-, .offset-, and order- variants tailored to different breakpoints.

methods.name: make-grid-columns
methods.description: A mixin that generates responsive grid classes based on the number of columns, gutter width, and breakpoints, enabling flexible grid layouts.
